standard-dialogue.npc: Hello there. What do you need?

steps.npc: This is one of the lairs of those foul Lizardmen. We've managed to corner these ones so they can't escape.
Cleive. Captain Cleive. Captain in the Shayzien Guard and renowned slayer.
Absolutely. I'm part of a great family of slayers. You've probably met a few of them over on the mainland.
We learnt of a group of Lizardman Shamans causing trouble on the surface. I led a taskforce out to drive them back into their lair.
We suffered many losses but we've now managed to trap them in this cave.
We've lost too many men to be able to finish them off but I'm happy for someone else to do it if I feel they're worthy of the challenge.
Perhaps. I've lost too many men to be able to kill them myself but I'm happy for someone else to do it if I feel they're worthy of the challenge.

steps.player: What do you define as worthy?

steps.npc: You'll need to be favoured by the people of Shayzien. You'll also need to be on a Lizardman Slayer task.

options.text: Can I use my Slayer helm instead of a Shayzien helm?

steps.player: Can I use my slayer helm instead of a Shayzien helm?

steps.text: If the player has not yet learned the technique:

steps.npc: Yes that is possible, however I only show the required technique to those who have proved themselves a friend to Kourend.

steps.player: How do I prove that I am a friend to Kourend?

steps.npc: You'll need to complete the Hard tier of the Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary and have earned the tier five Shayzien helm.

steps.text: If the player has not completed the Hard Kourend & Kebos Diary:

steps.player: I don't meet those requirements. I'll be back when I do though.

steps.text: If the player completed the Hard Kourend & Kebos Diary and acquired a Shayzien helm (5):

steps.player: I have that completed! Can you show me the special technique now?

steps.text: Captain Clieve teaches you the secret technique. Any slayer helm will now offer the same protection against lizardman as a shayzien helm (5).
If the player has already learned the technique:

steps.npc: I have already shown you that secret technique.

when-attempting-to-kill-lizardman-shaman.speaker: Captain Clieve
when-attempting-to-kill-lizardman-shaman.text: Hey! These lizardmen aren't just for anyone. Come back when you have the right Slayer task!
Captain Clieve wants you to stick to your Slayer assignments.
